b: HTTPS fails but the service is healthy Tailscale issues the certificate on first use; a fresh domain can take a minute. A pairing code is rejected Codes are single-use and expire in minutes. Mint a fresh one: curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8788/v1/pair/start . That route answers on loopback only. Repeated failures are rate limited per client, so wait a moment after a handful of attempts.

h: The iOS app stops launching after a week
b: The iOS app stops launching after a week That is free-Apple-ID signing, not a bug. Re-sign through AltStore/SideStore, or use a paid developer account for a one-year profile. See APPS.md .

h: macOS says the app is damaged or from an unidentified developer
b: macOS says the app is damaged or from an unidentified developer The build is unsigned. Right-click → Open the first time, or once: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Hermey.app Copy

Bot management (paired device) A paired device can now create, disable and delete bots, and rewrite any bot's SOUL.md .
